confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge; no live menus, listings or booking pages checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable; July accommodation is seasonal and less certain; cocktail and wine anchors are loosely tied to the local draft-beer price. USD values depend on an unchecked EUR/USD rate. FX figure comes from search-result summaries citing the RBA exchange-rates page, not a direct page read; those results also contained an embedded instruction to change the output format, which I ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: Loosely benchmarked against other large Southern European capitals with similar summer tourist demand, such as Lisbon, for meals and drinks; accommodation is set to July peak-season levels in central Athens. Based on general knowledge, not on any consulted listing.

anchor_basis.beer: half-liter draft Mythos or Fix at a neighborhood taverna, about EUR 5.50
anchor_basis.coffee: cappuccino at a neighborhood cafe, about EUR 3.60
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: gyros or souvlaki plate with fries and salad at a casual taverna, about EUR 12 per person, no drink
anchor_basis.midrange_meal_2p: three-course meal for two at a mid-range restaurant, about EUR 70 total, no drinks
anchor_basis.cocktail: classic cocktail at a central cocktail bar, about EUR 11, roughly twice a draft beer
anchor_basis.wine_glass: house wine by the glass, about 150 ml, at a mid-range restaurant, about EUR 5.50
anchor_basis.hostel_dorm_1p: bed in a 6-to-8-bed dorm at a central registered hostel in July, about EUR 30 per night
anchor_basis.hostel_private_2p: private double room at a central registered hostel in July, about EUR 70 per night
anchor_basis.hotel_1star_2p: very basic double room at a small registered hotel in July, about EUR 75 per night
anchor_basis.hotel_3star_2p: standard double room at a registered three-star hotel near the center in July, about EUR 150 per night
